in_sanskrit.name: Apnavi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Her Own
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Apnavi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। This name derives from the Sanskrit root 'apna' meaning 'one's own'. Apnavi is a name that signifies individuality, uniqueness, and self-possession. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of a divine being who embodies the essence of personal freedom and autonomy.
